page_title: ROM 0-2 ATA | AS Roma v Atalanta 02/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The foul by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marco Guida.
90+4' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+3' Matias Soule (AS Roma) takes the corner but it's cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+2' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Atalanta earn a free kick.
90+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A yellow card for a tackle by Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta). Marco Guida doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

89' 0 - 2 Juan Cuadrado takes over corner duties and expertly finds Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the right side of the goal. The score is now 0:2.
89' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
88' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.
88' That's a free kick to Atalanta.
87' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
86' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.

85' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Mile Svilar, who pulls off a comfortable save!
83' Here is a change. Odilon Kossounou is going off and Tullio Gritti gives the last tactical orders to Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta).
83' Ederson (Atalanta) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
82' A dangerous looking corner kick from Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is cleared to safety by the defence.
82' Substitution. Paulo Dybala is replaced by Matias Soule (AS Roma).
82' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Bryan Cristante is replaced by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).
80' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
78' Marco Guida shows the yellow card to Isak Hien (Atalanta) for a heavy challenge.
77' Alexis Saelemaekers received a sweet pass from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), but the advance is stopped.
77' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.

76' Alexis Saelemaekers swings in an inviting cross that finds Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma). He doesn't take advantage as his effort goes harmlessly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
75' AS Roma have a free kick. Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marco Guida blows his whistle for an infringement.
74' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) replacing Mats Hummels.
72' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Zeki Celik and he is replaced by Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma).
69' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Marten de Roon (Atalanta) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Mile Svilar. He makes it 0:1.
69' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
68' Atalanta are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

66' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
65' Eldor Shomurodov latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) and heads towards goal.
64' That's the end of the game for Ademola Lookman, who is replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta).
63' The game has come to an end for Charles De Ketelaere. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) is coming onto the pitch as Artem Dovbyk cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' Rough tackle by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
61' Manu Kone (AS Roma) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marco Guida blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
60' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will take a throw-in.
57' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
56' Marco Guida blows his whistle after Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
54' Tullio Gritti has decided to make a change. Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) replaces Matteo Ruggeri.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch for Mateo Retegui.
53' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
52' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) touches the ball with his hand.
50' Marco Guida blows his whistle and signals a foul after Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) brought his opponent down. AS Roma will take a free kick.

48' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
48' Wonderful movement by AS Roma. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
46' The second half gets underway.
45' Marco Guida blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
44' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
43' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) jumps into a tackle and Marco Guida signals a foul. Atalanta have a free kick.
43' Manu Kone (AS Roma) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

41' Mile Svilar pulls off a decent save! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
40' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
38' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marco Guida blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
36' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
36' AS Roma are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
35' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

32' Artem Dovbyk makes a nice run and receives a pin-point long through ball from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma). It would probably have put him one-on-one with the keeper, but one of the defenders makes a great block.

31' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
31' Manu Kone (AS Roma) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Atalanta are awarded a free kick.
30' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.

30' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Mile Svilar makes a comfortable save.
29' A raking crossfield pass from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
29' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared.

28' Ederson (Atalanta) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atalanta are going to take it.
28' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Guida signals. Atalanta will take a free kick near the side line.
27' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends a chip pass into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi is quickest to intercept the ball.
26' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
23' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) has a goal ruled out for offside!

22' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. AS Roma are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
21' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma are awarded the free kick.
18' Angelino (AS Roma) makes a slide tackle, but referee Marco Guida blows for a foul.

18' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Atalanta will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
17' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from AS Roma for a penalty. Play continues.
15' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball has crossed the sideline. Atalanta are taking a throw-in.
13' Manu Kone (AS Roma) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
13' Angelino (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

10' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! It's a free kick to AS Roma, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
9' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
8' A pass by Ederson (Atalanta) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a throw-in.
6' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
5' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

4' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) squanders a clear opportunity to score. He was one-on-one with Marco Carnesecchi on the edge of the box and attempted to put the ball inside the left post, but was denied by a terrific save. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
4' It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.

4' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
2' Poor challenge! Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is penalised for tripping and Marco Guida blows his whistle.
1' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marco Guida.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
Show lineups
